'''GG-8''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine programmed]] [[GG-series hospitality droid]] who had been, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], serving as a waiter at [[Café Tatoo II]] in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for many years.
